news.thesis: Newsweek/Raw Story Nov 13 ~14-16 UTC: Peltola leads Sullivan 49.2% to 47.0% with 88% counted and ~35k ballots left; she needs ~56% of the rest to clear 50%; overseas ballots accepted through Nov 18 and the state runs RCV tabulation Nov 18 (after this market closes 12am ET Nov 18); FairVote projects a 50.1-49.9 final round so AP will not call off an RCV projection; YES needs Peltola to clear 50% in round one before Nov 18 and AP to call before the final count; my P(no call) 0.65 v market NO ~0.48-0.53 (YES 0.47/0.52); thin uncategorized market conflating 'Peltola likely wins' with 'AP calls before tabulation'
